purpose: Connect and evaluate hypothesis-conditioned completion, fitted covariance on training-only class residuals; reduce risk-certification multiplicity with valid fixed-sequence LTT; record purchased raw indices/values.
exposure: Fold0 previously exposed by v6-v9; this is development evidence, not new independent confirmation.
split: Same frozen pack and deterministic v9 propertrain200/cal200/eval117; derive only from metadata, never read v9 outcomes. Keep all unsupported units as zero-cost abstentions.
legacy: Original FoldWorld training-only rank/weight/basis, clipped LMM working score and acquisition simulator unchanged. Reuse run8 instead of another execution controller.
repair: Class residuals = propertrain AUC minus fitted class prior, shared rank8 covariance via existing fit_basis; residual center added to conditional prior. Each hypothesis conditions on purchased readings against its own mean; observed coordinates denote the same vector, not new replicates. Rank8 fixed a priori; no claimed inner-holdout tuning.
controls: All use identical clipped LMM statistic, pair construction, support/menu, budget16, QC-cost rule. This isolates acquisition-side model changes; it does not fix or validate the LMM score.

certification.order: Computed once from propertrain trajectories: empirical-safe candidates first, decreasing decision count then decreasing threshold; unsafe candidates decreasing threshold. Propertrain simulation is in-sample, used solely for ordering, never presented as predictive validation. Save orders before opening calibration trajectories.
certification.test: Exact one-sided binomial UCB at delta/8; first nonrejection stops sequence permanently, no skipping. Among preceding certified candidates choose maximal coverage; zero decisions cannot certify conditional risk. Separate marginal and conditional sequences/policy; same-distribution IID unit assumptions remain conditional and unverified under existing class-stratified folds.
certification.capacity: At delta/8 and5%risk,99zero-errordecisions sufficient; avoids153requirement from126Bonferroni claims.

forecast_diagnostic: Same4hash-preordered purchase attempts for every compound/model; QC charged; score only finite unpurchased cells. Compare legacy, conditional, class template MSE and Gaussian NLL of annotated true hypothesis. No true label passed to world update/acquisition. Preserve all117 units; class fallback retained. Paired unit bootstrap2000 draws seed10. This conditional truth-hypothesis diagnostic is not blind identification.
audit: Save purchase positions, source cell IDs, raw values including nullQC, full score trajectory and prefixQC. Calibration selections saved before evaluation. Source/raw replays must reconstruct exact purchases, score and costs.
pilot_gate: Repair conditional-risk arm must have certified calibration threshold, evaluation coverage>=.20, wrong/decided<=.05 and descriptive CP95upper<=.15 before considering global. No automatic fullfivefold expansion; honest blocking receipt if fail. Decision advantage over baselines remains a separate requirement, not implied by safety/coverage gate.
success_scope: Repair must preserve hypothesis-specific prediction and existing cost semantics. Predictive/decision utility assessed independently; no STATE, exact e-process, general dual-core or biological-mechanism claim.
implementation: research only; old freeze/data untouched; no API/GPU/new biological downloads needed
